title: Nie Xiaoqian
synopsis: This is the fifth part of our rendition of Pu SongLing’s short story “Nie Xiaoqian”.

fullText.simplified:
小倩（五）

    小倩是鬼。刚来时，她不吃也不喝。半年后才开始吃一点饭。宁采臣母子都很喜欢她，从来不说她是鬼，周围的人也都不知道她是鬼。
    几年后，宁母想让儿子娶小倩，但又怕她不能生孩子。小倩看出了宁母的心思，说道：“子女都是上天给的。公子是大富大贵的人，不会因为我是鬼就没有孩子的。”
    宁母放心了，跟儿子商量娶小倩进门。宁采臣十分高兴，结婚那天，他请了很多亲人朋友来。大家看到小倩的美貌，都惊得说不出话来，没有人觉得她是鬼。
    婚后的一天，宁采臣外出了。小倩一个人坐在窗边，看起来很不安，似乎在害怕什么。她突然站了起来，跑到宁采臣的房间，东看看西看看，像是在找什么东西。
    夜色渐渐深了。小倩似乎越来越紧张了。她在房间里走来走去，时不时看看窗外，时不时跑到房间里找东西。       
    这时，宁采臣外出回来了。小倩看到宁采臣，忙跑过去对他说：“你可回来了。快！快！那个剑袋在哪里？”
    “剑袋？什么剑袋？”宁采臣刚回来，还没弄清楚发生了什么事。
    “就是那个燕赤霞给你的剑袋。快拿出来！”小倩叫道，她看上去很紧张。
    “怎么了？你不是怕那个剑袋吗？所以我把它收起来了。”宁采臣坐着没动。
    “我现在已经是人了，不再害怕了。那个树妖要来杀我。快把剑袋拿出来挂在门上。快！它就要到了！”小倩急得快哭了。
    宁采臣这才意识到事情的严重性。他跳了起来，跑到房间里找剑袋。终于，在一个箱子的最底部找到了剑袋。他赶忙把剑袋挂在了门上。
    不一会儿，宁采臣果然感觉到有个什么东西像鸟一样落在了地上。那个带着杀气的东西似乎想飞进房里，但到了门口又突然停了下来。那个东西在门口走来走去，过了很久，才慢慢地靠近剑袋，似乎想要把剑袋拿掉。
    就在这时，剑袋发出了响声，一下子变得很大很大。然后袋口突然张开，把那东西吸进去了。又过了一会儿，剑袋安静了下来，大小也变回了原来的样子。
    宁采臣和小倩很小心地，一步一步慢慢地走近剑袋。他们俩人打开剑袋一看，里面只有清水而已。小倩高兴地抱住宁采臣说：“没事了！”
    从那以后，树妖再也没有出现过。又过了几年，小倩生下一个男孩。宁采臣的两个妾也各生下了一个男孩。他们在一起过着幸福快乐的日子。
（故事完）
fullText.traditional:
小倩（五）

    小倩是鬼。剛來時，她不吃也不喝。半年後才開始吃一點飯。寧采臣母子都很喜歡她，從來不說她是鬼，周圍的人也都不知道她是鬼。
    幾年後，寧母想讓兒子娶小倩，但又怕她不能生孩子。小倩看出了寧母的心思，說道：“子女都是上天給的。公子是大富大貴的人，不會因為我是鬼就沒有孩子的。”
    寧母放心了，跟兒子商量娶小倩進門。寧采臣十分高興，結婚那天，他請了很多親人朋友來。大家看到小倩的美貌，都驚得說不出話來，沒有人覺得她是鬼。
    婚後的一天，寧采臣外出了。小倩一個人坐在窗邊，看起來很不安，似乎在害怕什麼。她突然站了起來，跑到寧采臣的房間，東看看西看看，像是在找什麼東西。
    夜色漸漸深了。小倩似乎越來越緊張了。她在房間裡走來走去，時不時看看窗外，時不時跑到房間裡找東西。       
    這時，寧采臣外出回來了。小倩看到寧采臣，忙跑過去對他說：“你可回來了。快！快！那個劍袋在哪裏？”
    “劍袋？什麼劍袋？”寧采臣剛回來，還沒弄清楚發生了什麼事。
    “就是那個燕赤霞給你的劍袋。快拿出來！”小倩叫道，她看上去很緊張。
    “怎麼了？你不是怕那個劍袋嗎？所以我把它收起來了。”寧采臣坐著沒動。
    “我現在已經是人了，不再害怕了。那個樹妖要來殺我。快把劍袋拿出來掛在門上。快！它就要到了！”小倩急得快哭了。
    寧采臣這才意識到事情的嚴重性。他跳了起來，跑到房間裡找劍袋。終於，在一個箱子的最底部找到了劍袋。他趕忙把劍袋掛在了門上。
    不一會兒，寧采臣果然感覺到有個什麼東西像鳥一樣落在了地上。那個帶著殺氣的東西似乎想飛進房裡，但到了門口又突然停了下來。那個東西在門口走來走去，過了很久，才慢慢地靠近劍袋，似乎想要把劍袋拿掉。
    就在這時，劍袋發出了響聲，一下子變得很大很大。然後袋口突然張開，把那東西吸進去了。又過了一會兒，劍袋安靜了下來，大小也變回了原來的樣子。
    寧采臣和小倩很小心地，一步一步慢慢地走近劍袋。他們倆人打開劍袋一看，裡面只有清水而已。小倩高興地抱住寧采臣說：“沒事了！”
    從那以後，樹妖再也沒有出現過。又過了幾年，小倩生下一個男孩。寧采臣的兩個妾也各生下了一個男孩。他們在一起過著幸福快樂的日子。
（故事完）

sentences.pinyin: jiù zài zhè shí jiàn dài fā chū le xiǎng shēng yí xià zi biàn de hěn dà hěn dà

sentences.simplified: 然后袋口突然张开，把那东西吸进去了。
sentences.traditional: 然後袋口突然張開，把那東西吸進去了。
sentences.pinyin: rán hòu dài kǒu tū rán zhāng kāi bǎ nà dōng xi xī jìn qù le
sentences.english: Right then, a noise came from the sword bag, and all of a sudden it became very very big.

sentences.simplified: 又过了一会儿，剑袋安静了下来，大小也变回了原来的样子。
sentences.traditional: 又過了一會兒，劍袋安靜了下來，大小也變回了原來的樣子。
sentences.pinyin: yòu guò le yí huì'r jiàn dài ān jìng le xia lai dà xiǎo yě biàn huí le yuán lái de yàng zi
sentences.english: Then the mouth of the bag suddenly opened up and sucked that thing inside.
After another while, the sword bag calmed down, and its size also changed back to its former appearance.

sentences.simplified: 宁采臣和小倩很小心地，一步一步慢慢地走近剑袋。
sentences.traditional: 寧采臣和小倩很小心地，一步一步慢慢地走近劍袋。
sentences.pinyin: nìng cǎi chén hé xiǎo qiàn hěn xiǎo xīn de yí bù yí bù màn man de zǒu jìn jiàn dài

sentences.simplified: 他们俩人打开剑袋一看，里面只有清水而已。
sentences.traditional: 他們倆人打開劍袋一看，裡面只有清水而已。
sentences.pinyin: tā men liǎ rén dǎ kāi jiàn dài yí kàn lǐ miàn zhǐ yǒu qīng shuǐ ér yǐ
sentences.english: Ning Caichen and Xiao Qian very carefully, step by step, slowly walked closer to the sword bag.

sentences.simplified: 小倩高兴地抱住宁采臣说：“没事了！”
sentences.traditional: 小倩高興地抱住寧采臣說：“沒事了！”
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo qiàn gāo xìng de bào zhù nìng cǎi chén shuō méi shì le
sentences.english: They both opened the sword bag to look, but there was nothing more than clear water inside.
Xiao Qian happily hugged Ning Caichen and said: “It’s all right now!”

sentences.simplified: 从那以后，树妖再也没有出现过。
sentences.traditional: 從那以後，樹妖再也沒有出現過。
sentences.pinyin: cóng nà yǐ hòu shù yāo zài yě méi yǒu chū xiàn guò

sentences.simplified: 又过了几年，小倩生下一个男孩。
sentences.traditional: 又過了幾年，小倩生下一個男孩。
sentences.pinyin: yòu guò le jǐ nián xiǎo qiàn shēng xià yí ge nán hái
sentences.english: After that, the tree demon never appeared again.

sentences.simplified: 宁采臣的两个妾也各生下了一个男孩。
sentences.traditional: 寧采臣的兩個妾也各生下了一個男孩。
sentences.pinyin: nìng cǎi chén de liǎng ge qiè yě gè shēng xià le yí ge nán hái
sentences.english: Another few years went by, and Xiao Qian gave birth to a boy.

sentences.simplified: 他们在一起过着幸福快乐的日子。
sentences.traditional: 他們在一起過著幸福快樂的日子。
sentences.pinyin: tā men zài yì qǐ guò zhe xìng fú kuài lè de rì zi
sentences.english: Each of Ning Caichen’s two concubines also gave birth to a son.
They lived happily ever after together.

sentences.simplified: （故事完）
sentences.traditional: （故事完）
sentences.pinyin: gù shi wán

raw.synopsis: This is the fifth part of our rendition of Pu SongLing’s short story “Nie Xiaoqian”.
sentence_translations: Xiao Qian (Part 5)
Xiao Qian was a ghost. When she first arrived, she didn’t eat or drink.
Only after half a year did she start eating a bit of food.
Both Ning Caichen and his mother liked her very much, and never said anything about her being a ghost.
None of the people around them knew that she was a ghost either.
After a few years, Mother Ning wanted to have her son marry Xiao Qian, ..
.. but was also afraid that she wouldn’t be able to give birth to children.
Xiao Qian saw what Mother Ning was thinking, and said:
“Sons and daughters are all given from Heaven.”
“Son of an official is a very influential person and won’t be without children because of me being a ghost.”
Mother Ning felt relieved and consulted with her son about marrying Xiao Qian into the household.
Ning Caichen was completely happy.
On the day they were getting married, he invited a lot of family and friends to come.
Everyone that saw Xiao Qian’s good looks, was startled into speechlessness.
No one thought that she was a ghost.
One day after the wedding, Ning Caichen went outside.
Xiao Qian sat alone beside the window, looking very uneasy, and seemed afraid of something.
Suddenly she stood up, ran to Ning Caichen’s room, and looked left and right like she was trying to find something.
The night gradually deepened. Xiao Qian seemed to get more and more tense.
She walked back and forth in the room, looking outside the window from time to time, ..
.. and running to find something in the room from time to time.
Then, Ning Caichen came back from outside.
Xiao Qian saw Ning Caichen, hurriedly ran over and said to him:
“You’re finally back. Quick! Quick! Where is that sword bag?”
“Sword bag? What sword bag?”
Ning Caichen had just come back and had still not grasped what was happening.
“The sword bag that Yan Chixia gave to you. Quickly take it out!” Xiao Qian shouted, looking very tense.
“What happened? Aren’t you afraid of that sword bag? I put it away because of that.”
Ning Caichen sat still and didn’t move.
“I’m already human now, and not afraid anymore. That tree demon is coming to kill me.”
“Quickly take out the sword bag and hang it up by the door. Quickly! It will get here soon!”
Xiao Qian was almost crying from worry.
Only then did Ning Caichen become aware of the seriousness of the matter.
He jumped up, and ran inside the room to look for the sword bag.
At last, he found the sword bag furthest down in a chest.
He hurried to hang up the sword bag above the door.
Not a moment later, Ning Caichen sure enough felt that something landed on the ground like a bird.
That thing with an aura of death seemed to want to fly into the room, but still suddenly stopped when it reached the door.
That thing went back and forth by the door.
Only after a very long time did it slowly approach the sword bag, and seemed to want to take down the sword bag.
Right then, a noise came from the sword bag, and all of a sudden it became very very big.
Then the mouth of the bag suddenly opened up and sucked that thing inside.
After another while, the sword bag calmed down, and its size also changed back to its former appearance.
Ning Caichen and Xiao Qian very carefully, step by step, slowly walked closer to the sword bag.
They both opened the sword bag to look, but there was nothing more than clear water inside.
Xiao Qian happily hugged Ning Caichen and said: “It’s all right now!”
After that, the tree demon never appeared again.
Another few years went by, and Xiao Qian gave birth to a boy.
Each of Ning Caichen’s two concubines also gave birth to a son.
They lived happily ever after together.
(The End)
